Below is the planned schedule. Dates, topics, and assignments may adjust as needed.

**Class Format:** Class meets Mondays 3:30–4:45 PM in 2439 TNRB. Each session pairs a short lecture segment with live build time in Claude Code. Most of your work happens between classes; class time is where we install skills and review what you built.

**Note:** Fall classes begin Wed, Sep 2, but Labor Day (Sep 7) means our first in-person class is Mon, Sep 14. Week of Sep 2 is an online setup week. We DO meet Mon, Nov 23 (Thanksgiving break begins Wed, Nov 25). Last day of class is Thu, Dec 10.

## The six axes

The course is built around six builder skills, two weeks each. You will rate yourself on all six in week 1 and again at the end, and the chapters, the drills, and both exams are organized the same way.

| Axis | The question it answers | Weeks |
|---|---|---|
| **Agentic Workflow** | How do I build with AI as my instrument? | 1–2 |
| **Discovery** | What should I build, for whom, and should I? | 3–4 |
| **Design** | What does the surface look like, and how does it flow? | 5–6 |
| **Application Architecture** | How is it structured, shipped, and kept safe? | 7–8 |
| **AI Systems** | What intelligence lives inside the product? | 9–10 |
| **Launch and Learn** | How do people find it, and did it work? | 11–12 |

Agentic Workflow comes first on purpose. You will ship something in week one that you do not fully understand, and you will spend week seven learning what you shipped.

## Demos and peer feedback

Every few weeks a portion of class is given over to small-group demos: you show your real, deployed product to three or four classmates, they tell you what worked and what confused them, and you spend the rest of the session building on what you heard.

These are working sessions, not formal presentations. Bring something that runs. The first half of the course is mostly solo work, and these are your standing chance to see what classmates are building and get fresh eyes on your own product before the final.

## Sprints

Six sprints, one per axis, two weeks each. There is no separate final project: Sprint 6 is the culmination and is worth 100 points rather than 50.

| Sprint | Assigned | Due | Axis | Focus | Key Deliverables |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mon, Sep 14 | Mon, Sep 28 | Agentic Workflow | Ship & Showcase | Portfolio live, 1 prototype, 5 problems |
| 2 | Mon, Sep 28 | Mon, Oct 12 | Discovery | Validate & Commit | Worksheet, AI interview, customer interview, ICP |
| 3 | Mon, Oct 12 | Mon, Oct 26 | Design | Product MVP | Spec docs, core feature, 3 user tests |
| 4 | Mon, Oct 26 | Mon, Nov 9 | App Architecture | Progress Check | Self-managed, 5-min Loom video |
| 5 | Mon, Nov 9 | Mon, Nov 23 | AI Systems | Progress Check | Self-managed, 5-min Loom video |
| 6 | Mon, Nov 23 | Thu, Dec 10 | Launch and Learn | Launch and Learn | Deployed build, 5-min Loom video (100 pts) |

## Exams

Both exams are taken in the testing center on your own schedule within the window. They are closed book and proctored, which makes them the one place in this course where your own knowledge is measured without AI assistance. Each is worth 5% of your grade.

| Exam | Window | Covers | Items |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| Midterm | Oct 20 to 26 | Classes 1 through 6: Agentic Workflow, Discovery, Design | 40 |
| Final | Dec 14 to 17 | Cumulative, all six axes | 60, ten per axis |

The final is built with ten items per axis so your score comes back as a six-sided profile you can lay beside your self-assessment.
